entities.name: Sherlock Holmes
entities.description: Consulting detective. Unofficial: 'I follow my own methods, and tell as much or as little as I choose.'
source:
said Holmes, as we
      sat down together to our breakfast

entities.name: Dr. Watson
entities.description: Narrator, a doctor; recognises the cataract knife.
source: It is what we call a cataract knife

entities.name: John Straker
entities.description: Trainer at King's Pyland; a retired jockey who rode in Ross's colours for five years and has trained for seven. Married, no children, one maid. Found dead on the moor.
source:
The trainer, John Straker, is a retired
      jockey

entities.name: Mrs. Straker
entities.description: Straker's wife.
source: Mrs. Straker, waking at one in the morning

entities.name: Edith Baxter
entities.description: The Strakers' maid-servant, who carried the stable-lad's supper.
source:
the maid, Edith Baxter, carried down to
      the stables his supper

entities.name: Ned Hunter
entities.description: The stable-lad on guard on Monday night; found drugged.
source: the third, Ned Hunter, remained on guard

entities.name: The two other stable-lads
entities.description: The two King's Pyland lads who supped at the house and slept in the loft. 'Both sound sleepers.'
source:
They had heard nothing during
      the night, for they are both sound sleepers

entities.name: The lad who tends the sheep
entities.description: A King's Pyland stable-lad who holds the carriage door and looks after the sheep in the paddock.
source:
As we stepped into the carriage one of the stable-lads held the
      door open for us

entities.name: Colonel Ross
entities.description: Owner of Silver Blaze and Bayard; 'the well-known sportsman'; small, neat, dapper, eye-glass. Twenty years on the turf.
source: Colonel Ross, the well-known sportsman

entities.name: Inspector Gregory
entities.description: The police officer in charge: tall, fair, lion-like hair and beard. 'Were he but gifted with imagination he might rise to great heights.'
source:
Inspector Gregory, to whom the case has been committed, is an
      extremely competent officer

entities.name: Fitzroy Simpson
entities.description: A man of excellent birth and education who squandered a fortune on the turf; now a quiet, genteel bookmaker in London sporting clubs. Arrested.
source:
His
      name, it appears, was Fitzroy Simpson

entities.name: Silas Brown
entities.description: Trainer at Mapleton for Lord Backwater; a fierce-looking elderly man with a hunting-crop. 'A more perfect compound of the bully, coward, and sneak...'
source: is managed by Silas Brown

entities.name: Dawson
entities.description: A groom at Mapleton who meets Holmes at the gates.
source: What’s this, Dawson!

entities.name: Madame Lesurier
entities.description: A milliner of Bond Street.
source:
made out by
      Madame Lesurier, of Bond Street

entities.name: The dashing 'wife' of 'Derbyshire'
entities.description: The woman for whom the expensive dresses were bought. Never named, never seen.
source: Madam Derbyshire had somewhat expensive tastes

entities.name: William Derbyshire
entities.description: The name on the milliner's account; said by Mrs. Straker to be a friend of her husband's whose letters were sometimes sent to the house.
source: Derbyshire was a friend of her husband’s

entities.name: The stranger at the stable
entities.description: A man of gentlemanly bearing in grey tweeds, cloth cap and gaiters, with a heavy knobbed stick, very pale and nervous, rather over thirty.
source:
a man
      appeared out of the darkness and called to her to stop

entities.name: The midnight visitor
entities.description: Whoever came into the stable in the night and fetched out a horse.
source:
Obviously the midnight visitor was some one
      whom the dog knew well

entities.name: The man whose track joins the horse's
entities.description: The maker of the square-toed prints beside the horse's track near Mapleton.
source: A man’s track was visible beside the horse’s

entities.name: 'One of your neighbours'
entities.description: Holmes's phrase, to Ross, for whoever cared for the horse after it bolted; also 'a faker'.
source: I found him in the hands of a faker

entities.name: Lord Backwater
entities.description: Owner of the Mapleton establishment and of Desborough.
source:
which
      belongs to Lord Backwater

entities.name: The news agent
entities.description: Sends Holmes fresh editions of every paper.
source: sent up by our news agent

entities.name: The driver
entities.description: Drives the landau from Tavistock and back.
source: our driver pulled up

entities.name: Ross's jockey
entities.description: Rides Silver Blaze, disguised, in the race.
source:
I beg that you will
      have your jockey in readiness

entities.name: Mr. Heath Newton
entities.description: Owner of The Negro, a runner in the race.
source: Mr. Heath Newton’s The Negro

entities.name: Colonel Wardlaw
entities.description: Owner of Pugilist.
source: Colonel Wardlaw’s Pugilist

entities.name: Duke of Balmoral
entities.description: Owner of Iris, third in the race.
source: Duke of Balmoral’s Iris

entities.name: Lord Singleford
entities.description: Owner of Rasper.
source: Lord Singleford’s Rasper

entities.name: A Tavistock contractor
entities.description: Built the cluster of villas for invalids.
source:
built by a
      Tavistock contractor

entities.name: A chemist
entities.description: Holmes asks which chemist sold Simpson the opium; none is found.
source:
What chemist sold him
      the powdered opium?

entities.name: A clever counsel
entities.description: The defence barrister Holmes imagines tearing the police case to rags.
source:
A clever counsel would tear it all to
      rags

entities.name: A party of gypsies
entities.description: Camped within a mile of the hollow on Monday night; gone on Tuesday. (The story's word and its stereotype are period ones.)
source:
a party of gypsies encamped
      on Monday night

entities.name: The police
entities.description: Gregory and his men.
source:
I shall now recapitulate what
      the police have done in the matter

entities.name: The ring
entities.description: The bookmakers at the course, calling the odds.
source: roared the ring

entities.name: The racing public
entities.description: Have laid enormous sums on Silver Blaze.
source:
a
      prime favourite with the racing public

entities.name: Invalids at the villas
entities.description: People who come to enjoy the Dartmoor air; the villas were built for them.
source:
for the use of invalids and others who may
      wish to enjoy the pure Dartmoor air

entities.name: A jury
entities.description: Gregory thinks he has enough to go before one.
source:
I really think we have enough
      to go before a jury

entities.name: Silver Blaze
entities.description: Colonel Ross's horse, of the Isonomy stock, in his fifth year; favourite for the Wessex Cup at three to one on. Named for his white forehead; also a mottled off-foreleg.
source: Silver Blaze,” said he, “is from the Isonomy stock

entities.name: Bayard
entities.description: Ross's other entry for the Cup; later scratched.
source:
Silver Blaze
      and Bayard

entities.name: The other two King's Pyland horses
entities.description: The establishment held only four horses in all.
source:
containing only four
      horses in all

entities.name: Desborough
entities.description: Lord Backwater's horse from Mapleton, second favourite; finishes second.
source:
Desborough, the second
      favourite

entities.name: The stable dog
entities.description: Kept in the King's Pyland stable.
source: rushed across the stable to unloose the dog

entities.name: A dog at Mapleton
entities.description: Brown threatens Holmes with it.
source: you may find a dog at your heels

entities.name: The sheep in the paddock
entities.description: A few sheep kept at King's Pyland.
source: You have a few sheep in the paddock

entities.name: Three lame sheep
entities.description: Three of the paddock sheep, lately gone lame.
source:
three of them have gone
      lame

entities.name: Isonomy
entities.description: Silver Blaze's famous ancestor.
source:
holds as
      brilliant a record as his famous ancestor

entities.name: The Negro
entities.description: Heath Newton's runner (red cap, cinnamon jacket).
source: The Negro (red cap, cinnamon jacket)

entities.name: Pugilist
entities.description: Colonel Wardlaw's runner (pink cap, blue and black jacket).
source: Pugilist (pink cap, blue and black jacket)

entities.name: Iris
entities.description: The Duke of Balmoral's runner (yellow and black stripes); a bad third.
source: Iris (yellow and black stripes)

entities.name: Rasper
entities.description: Lord Singleford's runner (purple cap, black sleeves).
source: Rasper (purple cap, black sleeves)

entities.name: The bay in Ross's colours
entities.description: A powerful bay horse without a white hair on its body, ridden in the Colonel's black and red; wins by six lengths.
source:
a powerful bay horse swept out from the weighing
      enclosure

entities.name: London
entities.description: Where Holmes waits on Wednesday; Simpson's clubs; the milliner.
source: the sporting clubs of London

entities.name: Holmes's rooms
entities.description: Where the story opens (the street is not named in this story).
source: rambled about the room

entities.name: Paddington station
entities.description: Where the train to the West leaves.
source:
catch our
      train at Paddington

entities.name: The sporting clubs of London
entities.description: Where Simpson makes his book.
source: the sporting clubs of London

entities.name: Madame Lesurier's, Bond Street
entities.description: The milliner's.
source: Madame Lesurier, of Bond Street

entities.name: The 'Derbyshire' household
entities.description: The second establishment Straker kept. Its whereabouts are never given.
source:
keeping a second
      establishment

entities.name: A first-class carriage
entities.description: The train to Exeter, Thursday.
source:
the
      corner of a first-class carriage flying along en route for
      Exeter

entities.name: Reading
entities.description: Passed on the way west.
source:
We had left
      Reading far behind us

entities.name: Exeter
entities.description: The train's destination on the way down.
source:
en route for
      Exeter

entities.name: A Pullman car
entities.description: The train back from Winchester.
source: the corner of a Pullman car to ourselves

entities.name: Clapham Junction
entities.description: Passed near the end of the explanation.
source:
This is Clapham
      Junction

entities.name: Victoria station
entities.description: The train's London terminus.
source:
we shall be in Victoria in
      less than ten minutes

entities.name: Devonshire
entities.description: The county.
source: the quaint old Devonshire city

entities.name: Dartmoor
entities.description: Lonely, sparsely inhabited moorland; 'a complete wilderness' away from the few settlements.
source:
In
      every other direction the moor is a complete wilderness

entities.name: Tavistock
entities.description: A little town two miles west of King's Pyland, 'like the boss of a shield' in the middle of Dartmoor.
source:
Tavistock itself lies two
      miles to the west

entities.name: Tavistock station
entities.description: Where Ross and Gregory meet Holmes and Watson.
source:
Two gentlemen were awaiting us in the
      station

entities.name: The landau
entities.description: An open carriage from Tavistock to King's Pyland.
source: seated in a comfortable landau

entities.name: King's Pyland
entities.description: Colonel Ross's small training establishment on Dartmoor: the stables, the trainer's villa two hundred yards away, a paddock.
source: King’s Pyland, where the Colonel’s training-stable is situated

entities.name: The King's Pyland stable
entities.description: A long grey-tiled out-building across a paddock from the villa; four horses; a water-tap; a dog.
source:
a long grey-tiled
      out-building

entities.name: The stable window
entities.description: Where the maid hands in the meals; not large enough for a man to get through.
source:
the window through which she was accustomed to hand
      the meals

entities.name: The favourite's stall
entities.description: Silver Blaze's stall; found empty.
source: the favourite’s stall was empty

entities.name: The chaff-cutting loft
entities.description: Above the harness-room, where two lads sleep.
source:
the chaff-cutting loft above the
      harness-room

entities.name: The harness-room
entities.description: Below the loft.
source:
above the
      harness-room

entities.name: The paddock
entities.description: Between the villa and the stable; the sheep are kept there.
source: across a paddock

entities.name: The path to the stables
entities.description: Runs across the open moor from the house to the stables.
source: the path ran across the open moor

entities.name: Straker's villa
entities.description: A neat little red-brick villa with overhanging eaves, by the road, about two hundred yards from the stables.
source:
a neat little
      red-brick villa with overhanging eaves

entities.name: The kitchen
entities.description: Where the lads have their supper.
source:
they had supper in
      the kitchen

entities.name: The sitting-room
entities.description: Where the Inspector lays out the contents of Straker's pockets.
source: We all filed into the front room

entities.name: The parlour
entities.description: Where Ross and Gregory wait for Holmes's return.
source: awaiting us in the parlour

entities.name: The passage
entities.description: Where Mrs. Straker waits for news.
source:
who had been waiting
      in the passage

entities.name: The Strakers' bedroom
entities.description: Where Straker dresses at one in the morning; the dressing-table.
source:
he had picked it up as he
      left the room

entities.name: Upstairs
entities.description: Where Straker's body lies before the inquest.
source: he lies upstairs

entities.name: The knoll near the house
entities.description: From it all the neighbouring moors are visible.
source:
ascending the knoll near the
      house

entities.name: The hollow
entities.description: A bowl-shaped depression about a quarter of a mile from the stables, where Straker's body lay; muddy at the bottom.
source: a bowl-shaped depression in the moor

entities.name: The hard, dry moor
entities.description: The moor around King's Pyland: hard and dry, holding no tracks.
source:
This part of the moor, as the Inspector remarked,
      is very hard and dry

entities.name: The long hollow towards Mapleton
entities.description: Falls away towards Mapleton; must have been very wet on Monday night; marshy at the bottom.
source: there is a long hollow over yonder

entities.name: The moor close to Mapleton
entities.description: Where the man's track joins the horse's.
source: quite close to Mapleton

entities.name: Mapleton
entities.description: Lord Backwater's larger training establishment, about two miles across the moor (to the west, as seen from King's Pyland), managed by Silas Brown.
source: the larger training establishment of Mapleton

entities.name: The Mapleton gates
entities.description: Reached by a paving of asphalt.
source:
the paving of asphalt which led
      up to the gates of the Mapleton stables

entities.name: Brown's parlour
entities.description: Where Holmes talks to Brown for twenty minutes.
source:
talk it
      over in your parlour

entities.name: The villas to the north
entities.description: A small cluster of villas half a mile north, built for invalids; Simpson lodged in one.
source:
about half a mile to the north
      there is a small cluster of villas

entities.name: The gypsy camp
entities.description: Within a mile of the hollow; abandoned by Tuesday.
source:
encamped
      on Monday night within a mile of the spot

entities.name: The pits and old mines
entities.description: Where Gregory suggests the horse may lie.
source:
at the bottom of one of the pits or old mines
      upon the moor

entities.name: Stables and out-houses within ten miles
entities.description: All searched by Gregory.
source:
examined every stable and out-house in Tavistock, and for a
      radius of ten miles

entities.name: A garden-party in Plymouth
entities.description: Holmes's invented meeting with Mrs. Straker.
source: Surely I met you in Plymouth at a garden-party

entities.name: Winchester
entities.description: Where the Wessex Cup is run.
source:
bound for
      Winchester to see the race

entities.name: Winchester station
entities.description: Ross meets them outside it.
source:
met
      us by appointment outside the station

entities.name: The course
entities.description: Beyond the town; a new course of one mile and five furlongs.
source: to the course beyond the town

entities.name: The enclosure near the grand stand
entities.description: Where Ross's drag draws up.
source: the enclosure near the grand stand

entities.name: The weighing enclosure
entities.description: Only owners and their friends are admitted.
source:
where
      only owners and their friends find admittance

entities.name: The curried mutton
entities.description: The dish served at the Strakers' house on Monday night; the household ate it too.
source:
a dish of curried
      mutton

entities.name: Hunter's portion
entities.description: The portion of curried mutton set aside and carried to Ned Hunter; its remains were analysed.
source:
the remains of his
      supper left by the stable-lad

entities.name: Powdered opium
entities.description: Found in an appreciable quantity in the remains of Hunter's supper.
source:
an appreciable quantity of
      powdered opium

entities.name: Edith's lantern
entities.description: She carried it because it was very dark.
source: The maid carried a lantern with her

entities.name: The stable water-tap
entities.description: The lad on duty drinks nothing else.
source:
there was a water-tap in the
      stables

entities.name: The small table in the stable
entities.description: Hunter sat at it inside the window.
source:
Hunter was seated at the
      small table inside

entities.name: The chair
entities.description: Hunter found huddled on it in a stupor.
source: huddled together upon a chair

entities.name: The stable door
entities.description: Locked at nine; locked by Hunter when he ran out; found open at seven.
source: The door was open

entities.name: The stable key
entities.description: The key to the stable door (implied: Hunter locked it).
source:
The
      boy locked the door before he left it

entities.name: A duplicate key
entities.description: The police suppose Simpson used one; none has been found.
source: having in some way obtained a duplicate key

entities.name: The folded white paper
entities.description: Taken by the stranger from his waistcoat pocket: 'See that the boy has this to-night.'
source:
He took a piece of white paper folded up out of his
      waistcoat pocket

entities.name: The promised dress
entities.description: 'The prettiest frock that money can buy', offered to Edith.
source: you shall have the prettiest frock that money can buy

entities.name: A ten-pound note
entities.description: Simpson says the paper was one; one was found in his purse.
source: He says that it was a ten-pound note

entities.name: Simpson's purse
entities.description: A ten-pound note was found in it.
source:
One was found in his
      purse

entities.name: The red and black silk cravat
entities.description: Found clasped in Straker's left hand.
source:
he
      clasped a red and black silk cravat

entities.name: The heavy stick
entities.description: A heavy stick with a knob, weighted with lead.
source:
his stick, which
      was a Penang-lawyer weighted with lead

entities.name: Simpson's clothing
entities.description: Grey tweed suit, cloth cap, gaiters; found wet.
source:
dressed in a
      grey suit of tweeds, with a cloth cap

entities.name: Simpson's betting-book
entities.description: Registers bets of £5,000 against the favourite.
source:
An examination of his
      betting-book

entities.name: Silver Blaze's bridle
entities.description: Missing with the horse.
source: His bridle is missing

entities.name: Straker's mackintosh
entities.description: Found on a furze-bush at the brink of the hollow.
source: he pulled on his large mackintosh

entities.name: The furze-bush
entities.description: At the brink of the hollow.
source: flapping from a furze-bush

entities.name: The cataract knife
entities.description: Ivory-handled, a very delicate, inflexible blade marked Weiss & Co., London; it would not shut. Clotted with blood to the handle.
source:
an ivory-handled knife
      with a very delicate, inflexible blade marked Weiss & Co.,
      London

entities.name: The disk of cork
entities.description: Had guarded the knife's tip; found beside the body.
source: The tip was guarded by a disk of cork

entities.name: An assailant's blade
entities.description: The 'very sharp instrument' an assailant might have used on Straker's thigh. None was ever found.
source: inflicted evidently by some very sharp instrument

entities.name: The dressing-table
entities.description: Where the knife had lain, says Mrs. Straker.
source:
the knife had
      lain upon the dressing-table

entities.name: Straker's pocket contents
entities.description: The heap of things from his pockets, kept in a square tin box.
source: laid a small heap of things before us

entities.name: The square tin box
entities.description: The Inspector keeps the pocket contents in it.
source:
unlocked a square tin
      box

entities.name: A box of vestas
entities.description: Wax matches, from Straker's pocket.
source:
There was a box of
      vestas

entities.name: Two inches of tallow candle
entities.description: From Straker's pocket.
source: two inches of tallow candle

entities.name: An A.D.P. briar-root pipe
entities.description: From Straker's pocket.
source: an A.D.P. briar-root pipe

entities.name: A seal-skin pouch
entities.description: With half an ounce of long-cut Cavendish.
source:
a
      pouch of seal-skin with half an ounce of long-cut Cavendish

entities.name: A silver watch with a gold chain
entities.description: From Straker's pocket.
source:
a
      silver watch with a gold chain

entities.name: Five sovereigns
entities.description: Gold coins from Straker's pocket.
source: five sovereigns in gold

entities.name: An aluminium pencil-case
entities.description: From Straker's pocket.
source:
an
      aluminium pencil-case

entities.name: Three hay-dealers' accounts
entities.description: Receipted; from Straker's pocket.
source: Three of them are receipted hay-dealers’ accounts

entities.name: A letter of instructions from Colonel Ross
entities.description: From Straker's pocket.
source:
One of them
      is a letter of instructions from Colonel Ross

entities.name: The milliner's account
entities.description: For £37 15s, from Madame Lesurier of Bond Street, made out to William Derbyshire; one item is a costume at twenty-two guineas.
source: a milliner’s account for thirty-seven pounds fifteen

entities.name: The twenty-two-guinea costume
entities.description: A single costume on the milliner's bill; Holmes later calls it a twenty-guinea walking dress.
source:
Twenty-two guineas is rather
      heavy for a single costume

entities.name: A dove-coloured silk costume
entities.description: With ostrich-feather trimming: the dress Holmes pretends to remember Mrs. Straker wearing.
source:
You wore a costume of
      dove-coloured silk with ostrich-feather trimming

entities.name: A piece of matting
entities.description: Laid at the side of the hollow so that the searchers would not trample the ground.
source: A piece of matting has been laid here at the side

entities.name: Gregory's bag
entities.description: Holds Straker's boot, Simpson's shoe, and a cast horseshoe.
source: In this bag I have one of the boots

entities.name: One of Straker's boots
entities.description: Brought by Gregory to compare with the marks.
source:
one of the boots
      which Straker wore

entities.name: One of Simpson's shoes
entities.description: Brought by Gregory to compare with the marks.
source:
one of
      Fitzroy Simpson’s shoes

entities.name: Silver Blaze's steel shoe
entities.description: The shoe on the hoof that lashed out.
source:
the steel shoe had
      struck Straker full on the forehead

entities.name: A cast horseshoe of Silver Blaze
entities.description: Holmes pockets it 'for luck'; it fits the track in the wet hollow.
source: a cast horseshoe of Silver Blaze

entities.name: A half-burned wax vesta
entities.description: Buried in the mud of the hollow; it looked like a chip of wood.
source: It was a wax vesta half burned

entities.name: Silas Brown's boots
entities.description: Square-toed, matching the prints.
source:
his own boots exactly
      corresponded to them

entities.name: Brown's hunting-crop
entities.description: Swinging in his hand; later wagging 'like a branch in the wind'.
source: a hunting-crop swinging in his hand

entities.name: A half-crown
entities.description: Holmes offers it to Dawson, who dares not take it in front of his master.
source: replaced the half-crown

entities.name: A photograph of John Straker
entities.description: Gregory hands it over from an envelope.
source:
Might I ask for a photograph of
      Mr. John Straker?

entities.name: Gregory's envelope
entities.description: The photograph comes out of it.
source: The Inspector took one from an envelope

entities.name: Watson's field-glass
entities.description: Holmes asks Watson to bring it, and watches the race through it.
source:
your very
      excellent field-glass

entities.name: Holmes's pipe
entities.description: Charged and recharged with the strongest black tobacco.
source:
charging and
      recharging his pipe with the strongest black tobacco

entities.name: The newspapers
entities.description: Fresh editions of every paper; the Telegraph and the Chronicle report the case.
source:
I have seen what the _Telegraph_ and the _Chronicle_ have to
      say

entities.name: Holmes's ear-flapped travelling-cap
entities.description: Worn on the train.
source: his ear-flapped travelling-cap

entities.name: Holmes's cigar-case
entities.description: Offered to Watson on the train.
source: offered me his cigar-case

entities.name: Holmes's watch
entities.description: He times the telegraph posts with it.
source:
glancing
      at his watch

entities.name: The telegraph posts
entities.description: Sixty yards apart on this line.
source:
the telegraph posts upon this line are sixty
      yards apart

entities.name: The telegrams
entities.description: From Colonel Ross and Inspector Gregory, inviting Holmes's co-operation (Tuesday evening).
source: I received telegrams from both Colonel Ross

entities.name: Holmes's special wire
entities.description: Sent to Dartmoor on Wednesday about the stable door.
source:
I sent a
      special wire to Dartmoor yesterday

entities.name: The reward
entities.description: A large reward has been offered for the horse.
source: a large reward has been offered

entities.name: Ross's drag
entities.description: A carriage from which they watch the race.
source: we drove in his drag

entities.name: The race card
entities.description: Lists the six entries for the Wessex Plate with their colours.
source:
I
      glanced at the card to see the entries

entities.name: The numbers board
entities.description: Shows all six runners are there.
source: There are the numbers up

entities.name: Ross's colours
entities.description: Black cap, red jacket.
source: Silver Blaze (black cap, red jacket)

entities.name: Spirits of wine
entities.description: Wash the horse's face and leg in it to find Silver Blaze.
source: wash his face and his leg in spirits of wine

entities.name: The disguise on the horse
entities.description: Whatever hides the white forehead and mottled leg. Its nature is never named.
